title: Rye Tai
steps: Add lemon juice, pineapple juice, orgeat and rye to a shaker tin with ice. Roll into a tumbler; do not shake.
Float bitters and garnish with a black cherry.
sourceNote: Adapted from Fork & Fire cocktail recipes.
reviewFlags: The source does not specify an amount for the bitters.
